description: This file defines the enum LoanRescheduleStrategyMethod, which specifies various strategies for rescheduling loan repayments within the Apache Fineract project. It includes strategy types such as rescheduling next repayments, reducing installments, reducing EMI amount, and adjusting the last unpaid period.
